name: examsphere-ai-root
description: ExamSphere AI - Voice-Based Accessible Examination System Orchestrator

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
